note: One organisation, one owning agent, one ask. Set 11 October 2026 after the founder found fourteen organisations approached by both Marketsom and Growsom, several with a different ask each time. Ownership follows what the organisation IS, not which agent emailed it first, because the first email was often the wrong ask.

lanes.Growsom: Investors, and collaboration that is technical: apps, data platforms, aggregators, SDK and integration partners, developer communities, research labs as design partners. Anything whose value to Vybe is an integration, a data flow or money in.
lanes.Marketsom: Communities of adults: leagues, clubs, associations, race organisers, member bodies, employer and first-responder programmes. Anything whose value to Vybe is reach to members at no cost.
lanes.nobody: Suppliers, manufacturers, contract engineering, battery, PCBA and sensor vendors. They sell to Vybe. That is procurement and it belongs to the founders, not to an outreach lane.
